sara_pm: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — consolidated remediation items below. Please claim an item with: owner / JIRA / RACI (R/A/C/I) / due (YYYY-MM-DD).

Items:
1) Fix selector race causing rollout fallback loops (repro: cold-cache + concurrent selector).
2) KV-warmup canary pipeline to exercise realistic warm paths before rollouts.
3) Incident playbook entry + runbook link for fallback/latency spike mitigation.
4) Billing guardrail: anomaly detection + temporary throttle on runaway fallbacks.

cedric_sre: I'll own 1. cedric_sre / JIRA: RI-3001 / RACI: R=cedric_sre A=sara_pm C=hana_platform I=eng-sre / due: 2026-05-20

hana_platform: I'll take 2. hana_platform / JIRA: RI-3002 / RACI: R=hana_platform A=platform-lead C=cedric_sre I=platform-team / due: 2026-06-01

cedric_sre: For RI-3001 I'll add a small harness that reproduces the race and a regression test in model-selector CI.

violet_finance: I'll pair on 4 with runtime. violet_finance / JIRA: RI-3004 / RACI: R=violet_finance A=finance C=hana_platform,liz_runtime I=product / due: 2026-05-28

hana_platform: For 2: prototype will replay a 5-minute sample to warm KV caches. Cost est ~1.5 GPU-hours per run. If stable we can hand off to runtime for CI gating.

cedric_sre: I'll draft 3 as well since it's tightly coupled to the mitigation steps: cedric_sre / JIRA: RI-3003 / RACI: R=cedric_sre A=eng-sre C=oncall I=product / due: 2026-05-10

sara_pm: Recap: RI-3001=cedric_sre (selector fix), RI-3002=hana_platform (canary), RI-3003=cedric_sre (playbook), RI-3004=violet_finance (billing). Everyone please add acceptance criteria and a short test plan in JIRA.

ops-bot: Reminder: "PM remediation sync" recurring weekly starting 2026-04-08 15:00 UTC. Notified: cedric_sre, hana_platform, violet_finance.

sara_pm: Thanks — post here if you need to hand off or change due dates. Closing thread for now.
